taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Egwi (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 295.88 | 0.54518 | 0.54518
2 | 798.6 | 3.5924 | 4.1376
3 | 864.62 | 2.1559 | 6.2935
4 | 1810.2 | 37.957 | 37.25
5 | 5634.2 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as A-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Egwi
Curve type: A-type
Aquifer depth: 6.29 m – 37.25 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately-high resistivity layer (≈1810 Ω·m) between about 6.3 m and 37.3 m depth as the main water-bearing zone; case off the shallower, lower-resistivity overburden (0–6.3 m) and set well screens within the 6.3–37.3 m interval, confirming lithology with drill cuttings before finalizing screen placement.
